skill.displayName: Locate your position on modern Windows
skill.summary: Geolocate the current Windows machine using the native WinRT Location API (PowerShell 5.1). No external API keys, no browser, no dependencies — uses Windows....

latestVersion.changelog:
- Improved script error handling; script now outputs structured JSON error messages if an error occurs.
- Standardized JSON output format to always include "error" and "message" fields alongside latitude, longitude, accuracy, and timestamp.
- No code logic changes; functionality remains the same, but output is more reliable and user-friendly.
